newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam Airlines continues meteoric rise in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam Airlines continues meteoric rise in 1996.

text.p: Vietnam Airlines said on Wednesday that it enjoyed another year of strong growth in 1996, with passenger numbers rising by 13.8 percent.
An official at the state-owned flag carrier said Vietnam Airlines carried 2.5 million passengers, 40 percent of whom were foreigners, on more than 25,600 flights in 1996.
That compared with less than half a million passengers just five years earlier.
Industry experts forecast a staggering 1,300 percent rise in Vietnam's international traffic to over 17 million by 2010 as the population and its economy balloon.

To meet that demand, the airline has begun renewing its fleet with new planes manufactured by Airbus Industrie and Boeing Co and plans to phase out outdated Russian-made Tupolev, Yakovlev and Ilyushins this year.
The Vietnam Airlines official said cargo volume was 44,012 tonnes in 1996, a rise of 34.2 percent from the previous year.
